remaining_gates: Model-scale hook activation retention and peak VRAM
Production checkpoint and inference base-then-adapter synchronization
Useful novel direction selection and measurable rank growth
Matched 100-update RL performance against retained historical standard
rank_order: ranks follows distributed all_gather_object rank order 0 through 7; selection details saved for rank 0 only
input_saving: Custom identity autograd Function uses save_for_backward; no input tensor captured by Python callback
limitations: Tiny native FSDP2 hook/selection/transfer/replay fixture; dense oracle remains fixture-only and captures inputs separately, so this is not a memory benchmark. CPU weak-reference tests demonstrate discard/recompute participation and callback single-use. No production RL worker, inference synchronization, full-scale peak VRAM, useful learned-rank or reward validation. Identity autograd output is a view; downstream in-place modification is unsupported.
